mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cold_chain_agent_execution ( request_id, agent_code, agent_name, question_length, execution_status, create_time ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{agentCode}, #{agentName}, #{questionLength}, #{executionStatus}, #{createTime} )
